principles.rationale: One versioned entrypoint resolves all essential code, evidence, environments and configuration roles. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.
Every result identifies exact source bytes, inputs, collector and environment versions. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.
An authorized recipient can execute documented collection and recovery procedures. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.

Canonical records, disposable projections and restricted artifacts have separate interfaces and routing. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.
The workflow reconstructs on a fresh supported host without undocumented author state. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.

Execution environments and indexes can be discarded without losing durable evidence or pending work. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.

An intended authorized recipient can retrieve exact essential components and restore the workflow. Assessor-inferred priority from the stated small-team use case; normative requirements remain unchanged.
